title: Required profile metadata is absent
description: The architecture document omits the owner field required by the project profile.

analysis.observation: The document front matter contains status but does not contain owner.

impact.statement: Reviewers may be unable to identify the accountable owner for the architecture document.

confidence.rationale: The project profile explicitly requires owner and the field is absent.

treatment.rationale: The divergence is deterministic and material to governance, but not urgent.

recommendation.summary: Add an owner value or revise the profile rule after human review.

review.notes: Approved by the human Tech Lead during Batch 01 review.
